what_changed: Exxon and Chevron reported surging Q2 profits but Trump threatened price interventions, and crude kept falling (WTI -9.3% in 5 days). A CNBC headline reports storms and a global supply squeeze sending copper soaring, so FCX is a new long. The Fed held rates; chips rebounded sharply for one day; LLY fell 4.6% in a sector-wide pharma drop.

oil_gas.why: Earnings are backward-looking, price-intervention threat, no new supply-shock headline.

gold_miners.why: No NEM catalyst; yields near highs.

pharma.why: Retatrutide Phase 3 wins; July 30 drop was sector-wide with no LLY news.

copper_uranium.why: CNBC: storms and a global supply squeeze sending copper prices soaring (named supply shock).

next_job: On the next decision day, check the LLY long (opened 2026-07-23, ends around 2026-08-06) for Q2 earnings, pricing or compounding news; check the FCX long (opened 2026-07-31) for news that the copper supply squeeze is easing or tariff/demand shocks; check oil for a renewed supply-shock headline before any XOM re-entry; then read the new record for a named catalyst in each family.

lessons.rule: Hypothesis only: oil longs opened on a named supply-shock escalation headline (sanctions, ship attacks, attacks deepening disruption) win over 10 days.
lessons.evidence: XOM 2026-07-07 net +6.82% (basket +8.64%); XOM 2026-07-10 net +12.76% (basket +10.51%); XOM 2026-07-15 net +8.22% (basket +6.06%). All in one Iran episode; below 5 cases, does not change calls.
